senses.gloss: Godānīya = Apara-go˚, q.v.: LV 〔149.19〕 (but Tib. nub kyi points to Apara-!); reported also from AbhidhK., 〔iii.145〕 of LaVallée-Poussinʼs Transl.; and with short a, Godanīya MPS 〔31.46〕.

godoha (m.; Skt. godohana is used in the same way, BR), (the time required for) milking a cow, expression for a short time: antato godoha-mātram api Bbh 〔156.19〕; (antaśa) ekarātriṃ dinam apy eka-godoha-mātram api Sukh 〔72.6〕.
